{{Short description|none}} {{more citations needed|date=September 2015}} This is a list of present-day cities by the time period over which they have been continuously inhabited as a city. The age claims listed are generally disputed. Differences in opinion can result from different definitions of "[[city]]" as well as "continuous habitation", and historical evidence is often disputed.
